name: How to Plan Your Kitchen Renovation Step by Step

step.name: Step 1: Document measurements and draft your scope
step.text: Measure the exact room dimensions, ceiling heights, door clearances, and current utility locations. Write down what stays in place and what moves, noting whether you want custom cabinetry, tile backsplashes, or a brand-new island footprint.

step.name: Step 2: Confirm permits and finalize trade plans
step.text: Work with your contractor to draft detailed layout plans showing cabinet runs, electrical outlets, plumbing fixtures, and mechanical exhaust paths. Submit these drawings to your local municipal building department to secure necessary residential remodeling permits before any demo begins.

step.name: Step 3: Complete selective demolition and framing changes
step.text: Protect adjacent living spaces with dust barriers, disconnect plumbing and electrical feeds safely, and strip out old cabinets, countertops, and flooring. If you are modifying room layouts, reframe walls or header openings according to the approved engineering and structural plan.

step.name: Step 4: Execute rough-in plumbing, mechanical, and electrical work
step.text: Licensed trades install new supply lines, drains, dedicated appliance circuits, lighting feeds, and kitchen ventilation ductwork inside open wall cavities. Schedule and pass all required rough-in building and trade inspections before closing the walls.

step.name: Step 5: Hang drywall, complete finish carpentry, and install finishes
step.text: Hang, tape, and smooth moisture-resistant drywall, then paint interior surfaces. Set base and upper cabinetry, measure for countertops, install tile or hardwood flooring, and set backsplash tile. Finally, connect finished plumbing fixtures, trim electrical devices, and pass final municipal inspections. For hands-on kitchen renovation management from framing to tile and finish carpentry, reach out to HH Remodeling LLC at 303-505-0866.
